purpose: Require real affected people to define the issue, compare alternatives and change, pause or reject a pilot before any G2 deployment.
non_claim: This protocol is a research-ready participation contract, not evidence that residents, disabled people, operators or other affected groups have already participated.
principles: participation begins before the problem statement is fixed
paper, telephone, large-print, accessible on-site and no-AI channels have equal standing
non-response is not consent and observed behaviour is not motive
rights, safety, discrimination and accessibility objections cannot be averaged away
participants can see the decision effect, receive a response and reopen a closed item
only minimum necessary records are retained; sensitive material is separated or deleted

stages.name: Accountable setup
stages.required_action: Name the carrier, convenor, accessibility lead, data steward, complaint owner and independent or community review role; publish scope and exclusions.
stages.required_artifact: dated responsibility sheet and accessible invitation plan
stages.decision_power: No recruitment or observation starts if accountability, safety or accessible contact is absent.

stages.name: Problem co-definition
stages.required_action: Collect self-defined tasks, burdens, desired outcomes and unacceptable consequences through walks, small groups, one-to-one, paper, telephone and ordinary-service contact.
stages.required_artifact: problem cards preserving group, channel, source date, uncertainty, exclusion and do-not-infer fields
stages.decision_power: Participants may rewrite the problem statement; model-inferred motives remain hypotheses.

stages.name: Conflict and dissent register
stages.required_action: Publish majority patterns, minority or outlier concerns, affected rights, unresolved evidence and response owner without exposing personal data.
stages.required_artifact: dissent log with retain/modify/split/pause/withdraw options and response due date
stages.decision_power: An unresolved severe rights, safety, discrimination or accessibility objection blocks G2; other unresolved dissent requires a separate alternative or reasoned public response.

stages.name: Alternative comparison
stages.required_action: Compare ordinary-service baseline, no-build/low-tech option, reversible AI-assisted option and exit state using the same public-value and risk criteria.
stages.required_artifact: accessible alternatives sheet and group-disaggregated consequence table
stages.decision_power: A low-tech or no-action option can be selected; AI is not the default.

stages.name: Pilot permission and baseline
stages.required_action: Record voluntary participation, informed refusal, ordinary-service fallback, observation window, missing groups, baseline ownership, human takeover and stop drill.
stages.required_artifact: pilot consent/notice, baseline sheet, missingness note, takeover drill and start decision
stages.decision_power: A pilot remains G0/G1 until affected-group coverage, baseline and takeover evidence pass human review.

stages.name: Return, correction and reopening
stages.required_action: Return what changed, what did not change and why; publish cleaning/restoration evidence; accept paper, phone and on-site reopening requests.
stages.required_artifact: claim-to-decision ledger, version difference, closure receipt and reopen status
stages.decision_power: The convenor may keep, modify, pause or withdraw; the rights/safety gate may require withdrawal.

minimum_disaggregated_baseline_fields: user group and self-described access need
waiting, detour, failure and human-transfer time
informed refusal, complaint, appeal and reopening access
missing or not reached groups and reason
observation window, numerator, denominator and exclusions
data owner, retention and deletion date
release_limit: Do not present this file as consultation completed, consent obtained, representativeness achieved or public endorsement granted.
